Technical Overview

What Libertas does

One view across investing, debt, taxes, and retirement.

Libertas unifies your account data into a private dashboard with net worth tracking, account drill-ins, rule-based insights, and planning tools. You decide how data comes in: manual entry, CSV/Excel imports, optional Plaid, and optional Google Sheets feeds.

Start with the happy-path guide

Theme system

Two interface styles, same data model.

Onyx

Dark, high-contrast workspace for deep analysis sessions.

Retro

Bright blue theme for a classic dashboard feel.

Recent architecture additions

Libertas now covers more than initial CSV ingest.

Recent ADRs and implementation updates include Tier-1 dashboard completion, optional Plaid + Sheets integrations with canonical source precedence, and at-rest field encryption options (Keychain or passphrase).

Use it as a private money OS.

Follow the user guide for setup, then explore technical docs and ADRs if you want implementation depth.
